answer: A mesa-berth auction stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch the mesa harbor auctions ocean-route berths; bids open at 20 credits, and each sale raises the next price by 2. Each winner locks a 70-credit bond to one key. 1,000 berths cost 1,019,000 credits for 8,000 in rewards. Rented bids fail: berths are key-bound, and repeat bidders show on the public ledger. The nadir price is 20, so an honest agent pays 20 once, keeping its full share.
